# Jamaica municipal roster backfill -- Vermont
# municipal fan-out batch 12; issue #163 (VT master tracking).

sources.note: 24 App. V.S.A. ch. 123B (Town of Jamaica charter): section 7: the selectboard has five members (three elected for staggered three-year terms and two for one-year terms)

Town of Jamaica, 2026 Town Report (official town website), town officers table: the officers table seats Jessica Pollack (term to 2027), Greg Meulemans (to 2028), and Kate Ullman; Robert Brooks is listed 'Appointed until March 2026' and Christina Robinson's one-year term expired March 2026

Town of Jamaica, Selectboard organizational meeting minutes, March 9, 2026: the board seated after the 2026 town meeting is Jessica Pollack (Chair), Greg Meulemans, Kate Ullman, Robert Brooks, and Jason Kass; Christina Robinson is not seated. The organizational minutes print Pollack once as 'Pollock' and Kass once as 'Kaas'; the town report and the board's later minutes print Pollack and Kass
24 App. V.S.A. ch. 123B (Town of Jamaica charter): section 7: a moderator is elected for a one-year term

Town of Jamaica, 2026 Town Report (official town website), town officers table: the officers table seats Tom Tolbert as Moderator; his re-election at the March 2026 town meeting was reported by Magic 967 (WTSA) local news -- newspaper-class evidence, disclosed on issue #163
24 App. V.S.A. ch. 123B (Town of Jamaica charter): section 8: the selectboard appoints the Town Clerk
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, and County Officials' (January 2026): lists Tom Tolbert as Jamaica's town clerk
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, town clerk contact spreadsheet (updated June 12, 2026): lists Tom Tolbert as Jamaica's town clerk contact
Town of Jamaica, 2026 Town Report (official town website), town officers table: the officers table lists Tom Tolbert as 'Town Clerk/Town Admin'
24 App. V.S.A. ch. 123B (Town of Jamaica charter): section 8: the selectboard appoints the Town Treasurer
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, and County Officials' (January 2026): lists Sara Wiswall as Jamaica's town treasurer
Town of Jamaica, 2026 Town Report (official town website), town officers table: the town offices page lists Sara Wiswall as Treasurer
24 App. V.S.A. ch. 123B (Town of Jamaica charter): section 7: three listers are elected for staggered three-year terms, one term ending each year

Town of Jamaica, 2026 Town Report (official town website), town officers table: the officers table seats Karen Ameden (term to 2028) and April Green (to 2028); Patricia Meulemans's term expired March 2026 and no official source publishes the 2026 outcome, so the third seat is left unfilled

Town of Jamaica, 2026 Town Report (official town website), town officers table: the officers table carries a single Trustee of Public Funds seat (Robert Willis, term expiring March 2026); the 2026 outcome is unpublished, so the post is created without a membership
